catecut: k'atek'ut — then; k'ate 'then' + k'ut written as one word
qui: ki — their; 3pl possessive/ergative prefix · ki — k- 'ongoing' + i- 'you (pl.)', written qui like the prefix 'their'; also k- + i(n) 'I' (inferred) · ki — fermented drink (inferred); noun, in qa ki 'our drink', after Brasseur · ki — how, so (inferred); a word of degree before utz 'good' · qi — truly (qi tzij 'truly'); written apart from tzij 'word', as qui ꜩih, after Brasseur's quitzih
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
huncame: Junkame — Huncame, One Death; name of a lord of Xibalba; jun 'one' + kame 'death' (kam 'die'), a day name; kept as a name
came: Kame — Came, Death; kam 'die', the day Death (Brasseur), in Wuqub' Kame 'Seven Death', a lord of Xibalba; kept as a name
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq
bec: b'ek — go; b'e 'go' with -ek (inferred), as in kat b'ek 'you go'
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
hunhunahpu: Junjunajpu — Hunhunahpu; name as written by Ximénez; elsewhere in the book the name of Hunahpu's father, here used of the boy Hunahpu (Brasseur notes the confusion) · Junjunajpu — Hunhunahpu, the father of Hunahpu and Xbalanque and brother of Wuqub' Junajpu; jun 'one' + Junajpu, a day name, 'One Hunahpu'
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain · Junajpu — also the name of a mountain (Brasseur: the Volcán de Fuego)
ꜭha: ch'a — says, said; ch'a 'say' (ca ꜭha 'he says', ca- ongoing; Ꜭha 'says' closing a speech)
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard') · ta — after mawi, marks the negation (mawi utz ta chuxoq 'it is not good that it be'); particle
cuꜭ: kuk' — with them; ruk' 'with him' with 3pl prefix · quk' — with us; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + uk' 'company'
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we')
petoc: petoq — come; pet 'come' + -oq, after kix 'you (pl.)' in a command
chivech: chiwech — to you (pl.); chi + iw- 'your (pl.)' + ech
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative) · taj — the second part of the negative ma ... taj 'not' (ma nab'e ki chakatajik taj 'not first their being brought low')
vl: ul — come, arrive here; verb, the root of kul and chul
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads') · wi — part of wikiq'ab' 'right (hand)' (inferred), written apart (vi qui cab, set against mox 'left')
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition · chi — ch- (command) + i- 'you (pl.)', before a verb
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered
vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
maihah: maijaj — wonder at, marvel (inferred); after Brasseur ('était émerveillé')
quehecut: keje'k'ut — thus then; keje' + k'ut written as one word
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
pachcab: pachq'ab' — (guess) a guard for the hand; pach (not explained) + q'ab' 'hand'; Brasseur pachgab ('gants')
quic: kik' — blood; noun, the known word, with the ejective restored (Brasseur quiq)
xe: xe — they; x- completive + e 'they', before an intransitive verb (xe na'ojinik 'they pondered'); also xe' 'root' in the title line · xe' — the foot, the bottom of (a tree, a mountain, a ravine); xe' 'root, foot', before the noun
vꜭhaxic: uch'axik — its being told, being spoken to; u- 'its' + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x + -ik · uch'axik — being called (kix uch'axik 'you shall be called')
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
huracan: Juraqan — Huracan; name of the Heart of Sky, meaning disputed ('one leg'? per Ximénez)
caquix: Kaqix — Macaw (in Seven Macaw), the scarlet macaw; noun
v: u — its; possessive prefix (Ximénez writes v), as in v xe 'its root'
xibalba: Xib'alb'a — Xibalba; the world below, the realm of the lords of death, which the missionaries took for 'hell' (Brasseur's note); kept as a name
xa: xa — only, just, merely; particle · xa — you (did); x- completive + a- 'you', before a verb (xa riqo 'you found it'), the same letters as xa 'only'
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
vxic: uxik — becoming, coming to be; ux 'become' + -ik (xe uxik 'they came to be') · uxik — (uncertain) finery, precious stones (Brasseur 'pierreries'), or perhaps xik' 'wing'; paired with vpuvac 'his silver'
rih: rij — its back; r- 'its' + ij 'back', as in chirij 'behind it'
vtuquel: utukel — by itself, alone; u- 'its' + tukel 'alone', adverb
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
habi: jab'i — there was, there is; existential, as in ma jab'i 'there was not' (mahabi in the preamble)
ꜭolic: k'olik — existing, being there; k'ol + -ik, positional/participle
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
tacal: takal — set, come to rest (inferred); said of alighting, striking, landing; sense inferred from the setting
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun · chuwi' — (inferred) after, later (of time), in ka chuwi' chik 'later on'; after Brasseur ('ensuite de cela')
hom: jom — ball court; noun, the walled alley of the ball game (Brasseur: the hall of the ball game, Nahuatl tlachco)
chaah: chaaj — play (inferred, perhaps at ball); after Brasseur's note 'to play'; the sense is inferred
pa: pa — in, at; preposition · pa — question particle after mi, 'has it…?' (mi pa xutzin 'has he finished?') · pa — after naqi, 'what (is it)?' (naqi pa); a particle of the question
nim: nim — great, big; adjective · nim — (inferred) respect, honour; nim 'great' made a noun or verb, in ki nim 'their respect'
chuꜭhaxic: chuch'axik — it is said, being called; ch'a 'say' + -x-ik passive, with chu- ongoing
xqui: xki — they (did it); x- completive + ki- 3pl ergative, prefix before a transitive verb
zac: saq — white, light; adjective, root saq · saq — (inferred) white dice or knucklebones, in xa saq, xa chaaj 'only the white (dice), only play'; after Brasseur
xere: xere — just so, this is how, only this; adverb
vꜩih: utzij — its word; u- 'its' + tzij 'word', possessed noun
ahalpuh: Ajalpuj — Ahalpuh; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Pus' (aj- + -al + puj 'pus', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
chamiabac: Chamiab'aq — Chamiabac; name of a lord of Xibalba, chamia + b'aq 'bone', 'Bone Staff' (Brasseur's reading); kept as a name
chamiaholom: Chamiajolom — Chamiaholom; name of a lord of Xibalba, chamia + jolom 'head, skull', 'Skull Staff' (Brasseur's reading); kept as a name
xiquiripat: Xikiripat — Xiquiripat; name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Kuchumakik; Brasseur 'flying basket' (hotte volante); kept as a name
cuchumaquic: Kuchumakik — Cuchumaquic; name of a lord of Xibalba; Brasseur 'gathered blood' (cuchuma + kik'); kept as a name
ahalmez: Ajalmes — Ahalmez; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Filth' (aj- + -al + mes 'sweepings, rubbish', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
ahaltocob: Ajaltoq'ob' — Ahaltocob; name of a lord of Xibalba, taken as 'Maker of Misery' (aj- + -al + toq'ob' 'pity, misery', after Brasseur); inferred, kept as a name
xic: Xik — Xic; name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Patan; Brasseur takes it as 'hawk'; kept as a name
patan: patan — service, duty, tribute (what is owed to a lord); noun · Patan — name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Xik; Brasseur takes it as a basket for carrying loads (hotte), whence 'office, charge, tribute' · patan — (inferred) load, burden carried (jujun chi patan 'each a load')
bi: b'i' — name; noun, here 'their name' after ki 'their'
conohel: konojel — all of them; ki- 'their' made k- before a vowel + onojel, as ronojel is r- + onojel
xꜩac: xtzaq — it fell, came away; x- completive + tzaq 'fall'
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki- · qumal — by us; r- 'by' form rumal with qa- 'we' (Brasseur kumal, his k is q)
ahau: ajaw — lord, ruler; noun, a title
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle · na — feeling, sense (inferred); na 'feel', the root of nao
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
queꜩabal: ketz'ab'al — (inferred) their gear for play; k- 'their' (ki- before a vowel) + etz' 'play' + -ab'al, noun of means; the tz' is that of the modern word for play, though Ximénez writes the plain ligature
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred)
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
cochoch: kochoch — their homes; ki- 'their' (k- before a vowel) + ochoch 'home'
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
xcaminac: xkaminaq — had died, dead; x- + kaminaq, kam 'die' + -inaq, the perfect
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow') · -oq — ending after a verb of motion marking the direction, written apart (apon oq 'arrive there')
cahau: kajaw — father; noun, paired with chuch
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik
xul: xul — it arrived; x- completive + ul 'arrive'
xchi: xchi — shall; the future prefix xchi-, written apart before the person prefix and the verb
canah: kanaj — leave, stay behind; verb root (chin kanaj 'I leave off'; inferred)
va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle
xbe: xb'e — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go'
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth'
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
vꜭhax: uch'ax — (were) told, spoken to; u- + ch'a(w) 'speak' + passive -x, as in xe uch'ax 'they were told'
hunbaꜩ: Junb'atz' — Hunbatz; name of the elder son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + b'atz', a day name (also 'thread, monkey'); kept as a name
hunchouen: Junchowen — Hunchouen; name of the second son of Hunhunahpu; jun 'one' + chowen, a day name; kept as a name
pixabaxic: pixab'axik — being charged, counselled; pixab' 'counsel, command' + passive -ax + -ik
choc: chok — let it enter; ch- (wish) + ok 'enter'
xmucane: Xmukane — name of the grandmother creator; meaning uncertain, x- feminine prefix
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
xcam: xkam — he died; x- completive + kam 'die' · xk'am — they took, he took; x- completive + k'am 'take'
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun · qaj — we want; q- 'we' (before a vowel) + aj 'want', as xkaj 'they wanted'
el: el — go out; verb (kat el 'you go out')
apon: apon — arrive (there); verb, with -oq after it
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find') · chu — he, it, before a verb; ch- + u- 'he', without the sense 'let' (chu maijaj 'he marvels')
cul: kul — it comes; k- 'ongoing' + ul 'come, arrive here' · kul — coat, smear (inferred); xki kul sajkab' 'they coated (it) with white earth', after Brasseur ('frottèrent') · kul — (uncertain) throat, neck, in chi kul 'at the throat' after Brasseur; perhaps the cul of ukulel
chupan: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside'
maui: mawi — not, no; negative particle, before a noun or verb
icou: ik'ow — pass; verb, without -ik when more follows in the clause
chicut: chik'ut — again then, one more then; chik 'again' + k'ut 'then' written as one word, the c shared
a: a — your, you (one person); a- 'your' before a noun, a- 'you' before a verb
chacatahic: chakatajik — being brought low; the verbal noun of chakataj 'bring low' (inferred), as in vchacatahic
chacatah: chakataj — it was overcome, brought low (uncertain); passive in -ataj
zaqui: Saqi — white; part of name Saqi Nimaq Tz'yis 'Great White Coati' · saqi — white; adjective, in plain use (saqi ixim 'white maize')
xꜭhau: xch'aw — it spoke; x- completive + ch'aw 'speak'
vbe: ub'e — its road, its path; u- 'its' + b'e 'road', possessed noun
rahaual: rajawal — its lords, the lords of; r- 'its' + ajaw 'lord' + -al
aham: ajam — carved; perfect participle of aj 'carve' (ajam che' 'carved wood')
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
chac: chak — (inferred) beat, defeat; after Brasseur ('afin que nous les vainquions'); the modern verb 'win' is ch'ak, but the word is uncertain and the ejective is not restored
mix: mix — has just; mi- 'just now' + x- completive
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun · uwach — its fruit (the face a tree shows); noun
tem: tem — holding (inferred, uncertain); not otherwise known; follows Brasseur's French 'holding his jaw'
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix · kat — you (one), of what is going on; k- 'ongoing' + at 'you' (kat b'e 'you are going') · kat — (inferred) then, so; taken as k'ut written cat (keje' kat 'so then', Brasseur quehecut), the letters respelled
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
huzu: jusuk — suddenly, at once; adverb (Ximénez's huzu is huzuc with its c shared with the next word cu)
quibil: kib'il — (to) themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + ib' 'self' + -il, in chi kib'il kib' 'among themselves'
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive · qib' — ourselves; q- 'our' (qa- before a vowel) + ib' reflexive
cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut') · cha — at your; chi 'at' + a- 'your' (cha mox 'at your left', cha wi ki q'ab' 'at your right'), inferred
bac: b'aq — bone; noun (ca bac 'our bones', the teeth) · b'aq — (guess) make fire, strike fire; a verb with the letters of b'aq 'bone' (xki b'aq ki q'aq' 'they made their fire', Brasseur 'battirent du feu')
xel: xel — it went out, they went out; x- completive + el 'go out', with no -ik because more follows in the clause
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
ꜩihon: tzijon — talk, speak; verb from tzij 'word'
xopon: xopon — he arrived; x- completive + opon 'arrive'
yaol: yaol — (inferred) given, giving; ya 'give' + -ol, an agent form; sense after Brasseur (the princes were tributaries)
chul: chul — come here (inferred); ch- (command) + ul 'arrive here', the person carried over from a command before it · chul — he comes here (inferred); ch- + ul 'arrive here', in a narrative sentence and not after a command
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written
zaquiric: saqirik — it dawned; saq 'white' + -ir + -ik (dawn, in a couplet with xꜫec)
chive: chiwe — to you, by you (pl.); chi + ive
yao: yao — give; ya 'give' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xu yao 'it gave')
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe)
